item.title: 【Cinema Center】MOVIE - The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants (2025) - MULTi 1080p WEB x265 10bit-MIXED
item.description:
Synopsis:​
Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following The Flying Dutchman – a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate – on a seafaring adventure that takes him to the deepest depths of the deep sea, where no Sponge has gone before.
Click to expand...
Audio Languages included:​
  • English
  • German
  • Spanish (Latino & Castellano)
  • French
  • Italian
  • Polish
  • Portuguese (Brazil)
Uploader Notes:​
This includes 8 multi-language audio tracks and 7 subtitles. There are many audio tracks available through Amazon Prime Video (including languages that are currently geo-blocked outside of the United States) but I only downloaded the ones that were in certain rapidgator/torrent sites. Everything was re-encoded to 10bit H.265 and AAC LC, but I tried to make sure the audio quality was the highest the AAC codec can offer while trying to be data-size conscious so it doesn't sound like pure garbage. Only the English audio track is in surround, and the rest are in Stereo.

The video being used as a base for this release was encoded by NeoNoir.

To those following the SB Dutch dub thread - the dub for this movie including the Flemish dub will be on that MEGA folder separately from this file once I find a way of getting them.
